resources.string: Beta. DELOS Tide is the frame generation of DELOS for streamed video: the GPU estimates the motion between the stream\'s frames and DELOS shows predicted frames between them, so motion looks smoother. Best with a game at 60 fps (60 → 120); a 30 fps game shows artefacts. Needs an Adreno GPU driver with motion estimation or frame extrapolation.

DELOS Tide is the frame generation built into DELOS for streamed video. The GPU estimates the motion between two frames of the stream and predicts the frames in between, so motion looks smoother without extra delay. Best with a game at 60 fps; at 30 fps fast motion shows artefacts. Needs an Adreno GPU with motion estimation.
Only the frames of the stream are shown.
One predicted frame per game frame: 60 → 120 fps.
Two predicted frames per game frame: 30 → 90 fps.
Three predicted frames per game frame: 30 → 120 fps.
